nativeApiAccess.note: Android v1 uses the local path and blocks paid image, dream and Living Mirror calls fail-closed with native_attestation_required before creating a session or contacting the backend. Since 2026-10-21 there are two exceptions, both only after adult consent and a Play Integrity token verified with Google: cloud narration (ElevenLabs; docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-21-celeste-vozes-elevenlabs-android.md, task V2) and the AI-written Anchor Scene, visions and affirmations through the scene-text provider, plus the Google Gemini translation of that scene when the user changes the language (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-21-celeste-textos-ia-android.md, task T1). Otherwise the server returns native_attestation_required, the app plays the device voice with a notice and keeps the texts assembled on the device from the answers.

nativeScreenshots.note: Replace web drafts with captures from signed iOS and Android builds.

nativeFeatureValidation.note: The generated Android prebuild passed autolinking with target SDK 36 and excluded the alarm module and forbidden permissions. Because expo-speech was added, a new prebuild and signed binary are required. The final AAB still needs physical-device validation of the ordinary reminder; visible image and text; full narration started only by a tap and completed, or full reading confirmed through the accessible alternative, before two repetitions are unlocked; system TTS with and without network; the chosen ElevenLabs voice through Play Integrity on the internal track and the device-voice notice outside Google Play; the AI-written texts through Play Integrity on the internal track and the on-device texts outside Google Play; on-device recognition; AI reporting; storage; network traffic; and final packaged permissions. System or browser TTS must not be described as always offline until the effective engine is verified.

aiContentReporting.note: The in-app report flow is integrated on the generated-content surfaces and, on Android since 2026-10-21, on every surface where the ElevenLabs voice plays (task V1 of the 2026-10-21 voice plan) and on every surface that shows AI-written text in full (task T1 of the 2026-10-21 text plan). Supabase migrations 001-011 are synchronized in production; a live anonymous report succeeded and its report and test user were removed.
